build_dataloader: build a dataloader for cifar100 or imagenet_val with augmentations and single class batching
create_ImageTransformation: create an ImageTransformation that applies random crops, color jitter, and normalization for a dataset
create_ClosestImagesSampler: create a ClosestImagesSampler that clusters dataset images by similarity using KMeans and a model
create_SingleClassDatasetSampler: create a SingleClassDatasetSampler that samples batches containing only one class at a time
create_ImagenetValDataset: create an ImagenetValDataset from an image directory and a validation ground truth annotations file
